infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: YUMZY uses your location only while you are using the app to help you fill in your delivery address faster, show your position on the map, and display restaurants that can deliver to your area. For example, when you choose your current location for delivery, the app uses that location to identify the address and show restaurants available for that area.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: YUMZY poate reda conținut video cu sunet în feed-ul aplicației.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: YUMZY accesses your photo library only when you choose to select and attach an image to a comment or review about a product. For example, you can choose a photo of the meal you received and upload it in your review to show how your order arrived.
